subject: [PATCH v2 2/3] mm: page_alloc: make the high-order watermark check honour ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT

2026-11-02.patch_summary: This patch modifies the high-order watermark check in the Linux kernel's page allocation system to honor the ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT flag. When this flag is set, the check should not consider free pages from other migration types when determining whether an allocation can be made. This change aims to prevent unnecessary stalls in compaction and improve performance under memory pressure. The patch also updates the __compact_finished function to follow the same rule for its fallback test. As a result, allocations that may not wake kswapd or reclaim will fall back to smaller folios instead of stalling in compaction.
